system_name: Agent Harness Token-Consumption Benchmark harness arms

published_implementation.historical_relation: The pinned study exercises native Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Pi and Hermes CLIs through a common metering proxy against one local DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 server. Exact historical package/source revisions for the five CLIs are not published, so W1 does not assert canonical revision matches.

benchmark.name: Agent Harness Token-Consumption Benchmark cross-module Hermes-Agent bug

result.model_config: 0xSero/deepseek-v4-flash-0731-spark EXL3 3.0 bpw on one DGX Spark; 384000 context; MAX_NUM_SEQS=1; common proxy forces thinking=false; Codex Responses API translated by proxy

provenance.publisher: Anders Jensen-Waud / Agent Harness Token-Consumption Benchmark
provenance.public_result_surface: committed 25-row per-run table in gen_deliverables.py re-derived by the publisher from authoritative meter logs, plus committed benchmark_results.xlsx and README summary
provenance.execution_environment: fresh workdir from immutable tarball each run; 3600s timeout; common metering proxy; objective pytest over two test files after each run
